resources.string: Still on. Review waiting readings and save your Add or Exclude choices first. Later defers them.

Choose Add for your readings or Exclude for someone else’s. Save choices commits your selections; unchosen readings stay waiting. Later keeps your draft choices without adding or excluding anything. Review deferred readings from Shared meter. Exclusions are remembered for this meter.
Add already committed. Save choices retries unfinished import; this is not an undo.
An older version of the app accepted these readings, but it can’t tell whether they were saved. Check each one against your log.
Not in your log within a day of this time.
Can’t check your log right now. Try again later.

A meter usually talks to only one phone at a time. Always: this phone picks up new readings in the background, and may reach the meter before another phone does. While app is open: this phone connects when you open the app or pull to refresh, and lets go of the meter shortly after you leave the app, but never during a transfer. If phones share a meter, choose this on each of them.
Choose Add or Exclude for at least one reading, or use Later to defer.
Could not finish saving choices. Unfinished readings stay waiting. Check storage and review them again; no unsaved draft is permission to add a reading.
